'''Celen''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Halla sector/Legends|Halla sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|The galaxy]]. A terrestrial world with a [[Human/Legends|Human]] population, they raised [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]] as well as [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]].<ref name="IC 501st" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Clone commando/Legends|Imperial commandos]] were [[Mission to Celen|sent]] to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Chelpori]] on Celen to capture [[Jilam Kester]]. However, Kester escaped, with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Iri Camas]] remaining behind to provide a distraction.<ref name="IC 501st" />
